BAD_REQUEST: The request could not be processed.
FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this.
NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
CONFLICT: This conflicts with existing data. Please try again.
TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests. Please wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
ACCOUNT_LOCKED: This account is locked. Please contact support.
ACCOUNT_NOT_VERIFIED: Please verify your phone number to finish signing up.
PHONE_TAKEN: An account with this phone number already exists.
EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists.
OTP_EXPIRED: The code has expired. Please request a new one.
OTP_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong attempts. Please request a new code.
OTP_COOLDOWN: Please wait {seconds} seconds before requesting another code.
RESET_TOKEN_INVALID: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
SESSION_NOT_FOUND: That device is no longer signed in.
REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED: For your security, this session was signed out. Please sign in again.
REFRESH_RACE: Your session was just refreshed in another tab. Please try again.
ADMIN_EMAIL_TAKEN: An admin with this email already exists.
